name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: A keycap for shortcuts in text and menus.
use: A key to press, in running text, in a menu row or in a hint. Write one keycap for each key of a shortcut.

instead.when: It is text a reader types or reads from a program, not a key

classes.name: kbd
classes.description: A keycap on a <kbd>, drawn with one half-pixel contour so it stays quiet inside a line

classes.name: kbd-raised
classes.description: A raised keycap that catches the light, for teaching a shortcut
